name: hERG structure-based cardiotoxicity benchmark
description: Compares methods that predict hERG-related cardiotoxicity from structural information to evaluate predictive performance.
reputation: Moderately used in the cheminformatics community for benchmarking hERG prediction methods; cited in specialized literature but not a broadly standardized ML benchmark outside the field.
notes: Assay and data heterogeneity (different experimental protocols and IC50 thresholds) and chemical series overlap can inflate apparent performance; dataset sizes can be limited for certain chemotypes. Not an LLM benchmark; risk of data leakage if commercial compound libraries overlap with training sets.
